items.title: What Is Hamilton Lane (HLNE) Telling Investors With Its Data Deal And Team Buildout?
items.summary: Hamilton Lane (NasdaqGS:HLNE) agreed a new data partnership with FactSet to integrate private markets information into FactSet's portfolio analytics platform. The collaboration is expected to provide institutional investors with institutional-grade private markets datasets and benchmarking tools inside a single analytics workflow.
